examined_formations.title: AGENTIC_COMMERCE_MULTI_PROTOCOL_AUTHORIZATION_INTEROP
examined_formations.chinese_title: 智能体商业多协议授权与支付互操作
examined_formations.structural_gap: Agent, merchant, credential provider, network and processor must exchange verifiable user intent and payment authority across evolving protocols.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: The cross-system authority gap is genuine, but UCP/AP2/ACP plus Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite and Mastercard merchant/agent products directly standardize or operationalize the same merchant-agent-payment handoff. A thin neutral adapter lacks durable authorization rights.

examined_formations.title: PRIVACY_ERASURE_DOWNSTREAM_PROPAGATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 隐私删除请求跨下游系统传播
examined_formations.structural_gap: A controller must locate and erase one subject's data across many first-party and processor systems whose deletion interfaces and permissions differ.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: MineOS already runs deletion actions across connected integrations and tracks manual-only systems to completion. The remaining long tail is constrained by endpoint permissions/API support rather than an independent operator-controlled right.

examined_formations.title: SUPPLIER_BANK_CHANGE_TRUST_VERIFICATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 供应商银行账户变更可信核验
examined_formations.structural_gap: Payer ERP records, supplier identity, bank ownership and change requests span organizations and cannot be trusted from one email or document.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Trustmi and PaymentWorks already verify vendor identity/banking, revalidate account changes, integrate into ERP workflows and in PaymentWorks' case even transfer fraud risk. The defensible asset is the incumbent trust network/risk position itself.

examined_formations.title: DEMURRAGE_DETENTION_INVOICE_DISPUTE_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 滞箱费与滞期费账单争议自动化
examined_formations.structural_gap: Carrier invoices must be reconciled against contracts, free-time terms, terminal events, container returns and closure/hold evidence.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: AuditDray directly markets line-level D&D invoice matching, overcharge detection and automatic dispute generation/submission. The cross-system gap is already the product.

examined_formations.title: CROSS_BORDER_RETURN_DUTY_VAT_RECOVERY
examined_formations.structural_gap: Refund eligibility depends on linking import declarations, returned/exported goods, logistics events and customs filings across jurisdictions.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Redo, Zollback, Valorra and related platforms already connect returns, customs documentation, duty/VAT recovery and licensed filing, including performance-based recovery models.

examined_formations.title: DEALER_OEM_WARRANTY_REIMBURSEMENT_BRIDGE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 经销商到OEM保修索赔报销桥接
examined_formations.structural_gap: Repair orders, labor/parts codes, evidence, OEM adjudication and reimbursement status span DMS and OEM systems.
examined_formations.evidence_summary: ServiceNow MCO now exposes dealer portals plus STAR-compliant SOAP integration that creates/validates claims from DMS data and returns adjudication/payment status, directly occupying the cross-system bridge.
